source_qualifier: source: real-chunk validation, pre-Phase-5 — not full-corpus accuracy
analysis_kind: post-hoc; no retraining and no test-label threshold selection

threshold_policy.selection_rule: maximize validation F1; ties: lower validation FPR, then higher threshold

world_model.selection_rule: maximize validation F1; ties: lower validation FPR, then higher threshold

feature_matched_baseline.selection_rule: maximize validation F1; ties: lower validation FPR, then higher threshold

construction.target_source: any corrected non-BENIGN labeled flow in the unseen final window
construction.model_inputs: numeric x, edge_index, edge_attr and observed timestamps from states[:-1]

empirical_test.scope: each raw numeric node/edge column aggregated over observed history by mean/min/max/std

findings.host_identity: Declared victim identities overlap positive and negative histories and training; victim identity does not separate the test labels.
findings.direct_target_leakage: No label-adjacent field enters x, edge_index, or edge_attr; no audited individual numeric feature is an exact test separator.
findings.narrow_correlate: Mean node scan_sequential_score alone reaches test ROC-AUC 0.9998908058528063, so world-model ROC-AUC 1.0 is narrow-correlate evidence, not evidence of a general architectural advantage.
findings.calibrated_comparison: The world model has lower test F1 and higher test FPR than the feature-matched baseline at independently validation-calibrated thresholds.

limitations: Host and single-feature checks can identify direct or narrow correlates in this chunk; they cannot prove generalization.
Validation threshold selection optimizes F1 on this selected real chunk and is not full-corpus calibration.
Real-chunk validation does not include a Lateral Movement transition; kill-chain diversity is validated on real data for the other represented stages only.
